figures.finding: Montenegro's Film in Montenegro cash rebate, run by the Film Centre of Montenegro under the Law on Cinematography, returns 25% of qualified spend (resident above- and below-the-line labour included) on a minimum spend of EUR 100,000, subject to a cultural test, with the request filed at least a month before filming; a 2026 interview reports it lifted to 30% plus 5% for shooting in the north (not read, see blockers).

figures.finding: The Film Centre of Montenegro co-finances domestic films through public calls; it is based in Podgorica.

value.fund: Film Centre of Montenegro (Filmski centar Crne Gore)
